def process(load_fraud_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_fraud_data.copy()
    
    # Set header from row 2
    df.columns = df.iloc[2].values
    
    # Keep only data rows (3-17, which are rows after the header)
    df = df.iloc[3:18].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Drop any fully null rows
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    
    # The first column contains Year values, second is Theft Type, third is # of Reports
    # Rearrange: based on data structure, col 0 is Year, col 1 is Theft Type, col 2 is Reports
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Theft Type', '# of Reports']
    
    # Convert Year to numeric
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove commas and convert Reports to numeric
    df['# of Reports'] = df['# of Reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '')
    df['# of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['# of Reports'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Drop rows with NaN in critical columns
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Year', 'Theft Type', '# of Reports'])
    
    return df

def process(clean_fraud_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    credit_card_data = clean_fraud_data[clean_fraud_data['Theft Type'] == 'Credit Card']
    
    data_2020 = credit_card_data[credit_card_data['Year'] == 2020]['# of Reports'].values[0]
    data_2024 = credit_card_data[credit_card_data['Year'] == 2024]['# of Reports'].values[0]
    
    ratio = data_2024 / data_2020
    ratio_rounded = round(ratio, 4)
    
    return pd.DataFrame({'Year': [2020, 2024], 'Credit Card Reports': [data_2020, data_2024], 'Ratio (2024/2020)': [ratio_rounded, ratio_rounded]})
